verified_key_information_units.information: The residential development portfolio expanded by six projects in 2025, adding approximately 700 planned apartments and 2,500 m² of commercial space, including the Manufaktuuri 3 site in Tallinn (planned for ~300 apartments) which allows for a high-rise building of up to 60 storeys.

As at 31 December 2025, the Group had 10 residential development projects on sale — 5 completed (355 homes, 327 sold, 28 unsold) and 5 under construction comprising 428 homes, a 223% increase from 192 homes at end-2024, with 227 homes under construction in Latvia and 201 in Estonia.
